description: Replay of the Toronto case (Project Lighthouse, 2026): a blaster in a vehicle downtown. Route, speed and range are assumed.

based_on.case: Toronto, Canada, November 2025 to March 2026 (Project Lighthouse)
reported: First flagged in downtown Toronto by a cybersecurity partner in November 2025
The device was mobile and run from vehicles across the Greater Toronto Area
Tens of thousands of devices connected over several months
More than 13 million network disruptions, which could affect 911 access
assumed: The exact streets: Yonge St from Front St to Bloor St
Range of 500 m; no range was reported
The lure wording and brand; neither was in the reports we read
How many phones run the app: the demo's density of about 19 per km2
